# Nikala UI — LLM & AI Developer Reference Manual

> Nikala UI is a copy-paste component system and reactive primitives suite for SolidJS built natively for Tailwind CSS v4. Honoring Georgian painter Niko Pirosmani (Nikala).

- Official Website: https://nikala.dev
- Current Version: v0.12.2
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/nikala-ui/ui
- Documentation Portal: https://nikala.dev/docs
- Desktop & Tauri Suite: https://nikala.dev/docs/desktop
- Interactive Playground: https://nikala.dev/playground
- Raw LLM Reference: https://nikala.dev/llms.txt

---

## 1. Core Architecture & Philosophy

Nikala UI rejects heavy `node_modules` UI dependencies for component structures and reactive primitives. Instead, it follows a 100% **Pure Copy-Paste Ownership** model.

### Key Architectural Pillars:
- **Native SolidJS Reactivity**: Fine-grained reactive signals, props splitting (`splitProps`), and explicit memoization (`children(() => props.children)`).
- **Tailwind CSS v4 Native**: Built on modern `@import "tailwindcss";` setups, CSS-first `@theme` variables, and semantic color design tokens without legacy JS configs.
- **Full Source Ownership**: The CLI writes components to `src/components/ui/` and primitive hooks directly to `src/hooks/`. Developers own, inspect, and customize all generated source files.
- **Tauri v2 Desktop Native**: First-class support for cross-platform desktop applications (macOS, Windows 11, Linux) with custom frameless window chrome, drag regions, auto-updaters, and native OS hotkey primitives.
- **Zero Lock-In**: Decoupled `@nikala-ui/cli` client, `@nikala-ui/core` registry, and `@nikala-ui/mcp` server for remote HTTP(S) manifest installs and direct AI IDE integration.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Native `@nikala-ui/mcp` integration supporting Stdio local execution (`npx @nikala-ui/mcp`) and remote HTTP/SSE streaming (`https://nikala.dev/api/mcp/sse`) with callable tools, pre-built AI prompts, and SolidJS engineering resources.

---

## 2. CLI Command Quick Reference

### Installation & Initialization
```bash
# Initialize Nikala UI configuration, cn helper, path aliases, and theme CSS
bunx @nikala-ui/cli init

# Initialize with AI assistant rules (.cursor/rules/nikala.mdc, .cursorrules, AGENTS.md)
bunx @nikala-ui/cli init --ai

# Generate or update AI assistant rules in an existing workspace
bunx @nikala-ui/cli rules
```

### Listing Catalog & Installed Items
```bash
# List all components and hooks with installation status
bunx @nikala-ui/cli list
# Shortcut alias
bunx @nikala-ui/cli ls

# Filter by locally installed items
bunx @nikala-ui/cli list --installed

# Filter by type
bunx @nikala-ui/cli list --component
bunx @nikala-ui/cli list --hook

# Output as JSON
bunx @nikala-ui/cli list --json
```

### Adding UI & Desktop Components
```bash
# Interactive autocomplete multiselect menu for UI components
bunx @nikala-ui/cli add

# Direct installation of specific UI and Desktop components
bunx @nikala-ui/cli add button input card dialog sidebar titlebar updater-modal

# Add all available UI components
bunx @nikala-ui/cli add --all

# Overwrite existing component files
bunx @nikala-ui/cli add button --overwrite
```

### Upgrading Components & Hooks
```bash
# Interactive menu to select installed items to upgrade
bunx @nikala-ui/cli upgrade

# Alias command to update specific items or all
bunx @nikala-ui/cli update button dialog sidebar create-clipboard
bunx @nikala-ui/cli update --all
```

### Removing & Uninstalling Components
```bash
# Interactive menu to safely remove components from codebase
bunx @nikala-ui/cli remove

# Direct uninstall of specific components or hooks
bunx @nikala-ui/cli uninstall button dialog sidebar
bunx @nikala-ui/cli remove -h create-clipboard
```

### Adding Primitive Hooks (Pure Copy-Paste to `src/hooks/`)
```bash
# Interactive autocomplete multiselect menu for reactive hooks
bunx @nikala-ui/cli add --hook

# Direct copy-paste installation of specific hooks to src/hooks/
bunx @nikala-ui/cli add --hook create-audio create-fetch create-clipboard create-tauri-window create-document-tabs

# Shortcut option (-h)
bunx @nikala-ui/cli add -h create-global-shortcut create-app-updater create-websocket create-drop-zone
```

### Theme Management & Diagnostics
```bash
# Set primary brand accent color and base gray palette
bunx @nikala-ui/cli theme set wine zinc

# Run workspace health diagnostics
bunx @nikala-ui/cli validate
```

---

## 3. Strict Engineering Rules for AI Code Generation

When generating or editing SolidJS code using Nikala UI components and hooks, AI models MUST follow these strict rules:

1. **NEVER Destructure Props Directly**:
   - `const { variant, class: className } = props;` -> **FORBIDDEN** (breaks SolidJS fine-grained signal tracking).
   - `const [local, others] = splitProps(props, ["variant", "class"]);` -> **REQUIRED**.

2. **Children Inspection & Tab Hydration**:
   - ALWAYS use `const resolved = children(() => props.children);` when inspecting, iterating, or conditionally rendering JSX children inside tab containers or dynamic branches.

3. **Tailwind CSS v4 Semantic Design Tokens**:
   - All components must use semantic design tokens defined in modern `@import "tailwindcss";` setups (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `bg-card`, `border-border`, `bg-primary`, etc.). Avoid hardcoded arbitrary color values.

4. **SSR Anti-FOUC Theme Script**:
   - When using `ThemeProvider`, ALWAYS place `<ThemeScript storageKey="nikala-theme" />` synchronously inside `<head>` or root HTML before `<ThemeProvider>` to eliminate flash of unstyled content during SSR.

5. **Hook Imports**:
   - Import copy-pasted hooks locally from project alias: `import { createClipboard } from "@/hooks/create-clipboard";`
   - Import desktop hooks locally: `import { createTauriWindow } from "@/hooks/create-tauri-window";`
   - Import document tabs: `import { createDocumentTabs } from "@/hooks/create-document-tabs";`

---

## 5. Reactive Primitives / Hooks Registry (48 Hooks)

Nikala UI primitives are written directly to `src/hooks/<hook-name>.ts`. Below is the complete catalog:

1. **`createActiveElement`** — Tracks currently focused DOM element (`activeElement()`, `hasFocus()`).
2. **`createAppUpdater`** — Controls and observes Tauri v2 application updates, download progress stream, and app relaunch (`status()`, `progress()`, `updateInfo()`, `checkForUpdates()`, `downloadAndInstall()`, `relaunch()`).
3. **`createAudio` / `createVideo`** — Controls media playback (`isPlaying()`, `duration()`, `currentTime()`, `toggle()`, `seek()`, `setVolume()`).
4. **`createBattery`** — Observes device battery level, charging status, and time metrics.
5. **`createChatScroll`** — Automated conversation container scrolling with manual user scroll-up detection.
6. **`createClickOutside`** — Detects clicks outside target element refs (`createClickOutside(targetRef, handler)`).
7. **`createClipboard`** — Copies text to clipboard with auto-reset status (`copied()`, `copy(text)`, `error()`).
8. **`createColorMode`** — Manages dark/light theme signals and system preference detection.
9. **`createControllableSignal`** — Primitive supporting both controlled and uncontrolled state patterns.
10. **`createDebounce` / `createThrottle`** — Rate-limits function executions and reactive signal updates.
11. **`createDisclosure`** — Manages boolean open/close disclosure state (`isOpen()`, `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`).
12. **`createDocumentTabs`** — Fine-grained reactive management for multi-document tabs, editor buffers, and browser tab stacks with mouse wheel scrolling, pinned tabs, unsaved dirty state, and adjacent activation on close (`tabs()`, `activeTabId()`, `addTab()`, `closeTab()`, `markDirty()`, `togglePin()`, `closeOthers()`).
13. **`createDocumentTitle`** — Dynamically updates browser tab title with restore on unmount.
14. **`createDropZone`** — Drag-and-drop file upload operations, file validation, and native file chooser trigger.
15. **`createEventSource`** — Subscribes to Server-Sent Events (SSE) streams (`data()`, `status()`, `close()`).
16. **`createFavicon`** — Updates browser tab favicon dynamically from URLs or SVG data URIs.
17. **`createFetch`** — Handles HTTP REST API requests (`data()`, `loading()`, `error()`, `refetch()`).
18. **`createFocusTrap`** — Traps keyboard focus inside modal containers for accessibility.
19. **`createForm`** — Handles form field state, dynamic validation rules, errors, and submission.
20. **`createFullscreen`** — Requests and monitors element or document fullscreen state (`isFullscreen()`, `toggle()`).
21. **`createGeolocation`** — Tracks real-time GPS coordinates, accuracy, speed, and heading.
22. **`createGlobalShortcut`** — Registers native system-wide OS global hotkeys via Tauri v2 plugin with web keyboard fallback (`register()`, `unregister()`, `isRegistered()`).
23. **`createHover`** — Tracks element mouse hover state with enter/exit delay configurations.
24. **`createIdle`** — Detects user inactivity after customizable timeout threshold (`isIdle()`).
25. **`createInfiniteScroll`** — Manages infinite scroll pagination and auto-fetching next page triggers.
26. **`createInputMask`** — Applies formatting masks (phone numbers, credit cards, dates) to text inputs.
27. **`createIntersectionObserver`** — Observes element visibility and viewport intersection ratios.
28. **`createKeybindings`** — Listens to keyboard shortcuts, key combinations, and Escape key presses.
29. **`createLockScroll`** — Locks body or scrollable container scrolling when overlays are active.
30. **`createLongPress`** — Detects long press / touch hold interactions with custom duration.
31. **`createMediaQuery`** — Tracks CSS media queries and responsive Tailwind breakpoints.
32. **`createMousePosition`** — Tracks global window and element-relative cursor coordinates.
33. **`createNetworkStatus`** — Tracks browser online/offline status and network connection type.
34. **`createOrientation`** — Monitors screen orientation (`portrait` / `landscape`) and rotation angle.
35. **`createPagination`** — Calculates pagination state, page ranges with ellipses, and jump actions.
36. **`createPermission`** — Queries and observes browser permission states (`granted`, `denied`, `prompt`).
37. **`createPrevious`** — Accesses previous value of a reactive signal accessor.
38. **`createResizeObserver`** — Observes element width, height, and content box bounding rects.
39. **`createScrollIntoView`** — Smoothly scrolls target element or ref into container viewport.
40. **`createScrollPosition`** — Tracks container scroll offset (X, Y), scroll direction, and boundaries.
41. **`createStorage`** — Reactive `createLocalStorage` and `createSessionStorage` with cross-tab sync.
42. **`createTauriWindow`** — Fine-grained reactive signals and actions for Tauri desktop windows (`isMaximized()`, `isMinimized()`, `isFullscreen()`, `isFocused()`, `minimize()`, `maximize()`, `toggleMaximize()`, `close()`, `startDragging()`).
43. **`createTimer`** — Provides interval timers, stopwatch counters, and formatted countdowns.
44. **`createTiptapEditor`** — Headless reactive TipTap rich text editor integration for SolidJS (`editor()`, `isActive()`, `toggleBold()`, `toggleItalic()`, `setHeading()`, etc.).
45. **`createUndoRedo`** — Manages undo/redo state history stacks and pointer state resets.
46. **`createWebNotification`** — Sends native browser desktop notifications and handles permission requests.
47. **`createWebSocket`** — WebSocket client connection manager with auto-reconnect and message parsing.
48. **`createWindowSize`** — Tracks window inner width and inner height reactively.

---

## 6. Desktop & Tauri v2 Suite Reference

Nikala UI provides a complete desktop-first UI system tailored for **Tauri v2** and **SolidJS**.

### Frameless Window Chrome & Tabs (`Titlebar` + `TitlebarTabs`)
```tsx
import {
  Titlebar,
  TitlebarControls,
  TitlebarTabs,
} from "@/components/ui/titlebar";
import { createDocumentTabs } from "@/hooks/create-document-tabs";
import { FileCode, Terminal } from "lucide-solid";

export function DesktopEditorHeader() {
  const tabs = createDocumentTabs({
    initialTabs: [
      { id: "main.rs", title: "main.rs", icon: Terminal, isPinned: true },
      { id: "app.tsx", title: "App.tsx", icon: FileCode, isDirty: true },
    ],
    enableKeybindings: true, // Enables Ctrl+W / Cmd+W to close active tab
  });

  const handleAddTab = () => {
    const id = `doc-${tabs.count() + 1}.ts`;
    tabs.addTab({ id, title: id, icon: FileCode });
  };

  return (
    <Titlebar platform="macos" class="h-10 bg-card border-b">
      <TitlebarControls platform="macos" class="mr-2" />

      {/* 1-Liner Declarative Tabs with Mouse Wheel Scrolling & Anchored Add Button */}
      <TitlebarTabs
        manager={tabs}
        variant="editor"
        onAddTab={handleAddTab}
      />
    </Titlebar>
  );
}
```

### Tauri Auto-Updater Modal (`UpdaterModal` + `createAppUpdater`)
```tsx
import { createSignal } from "solid-js";
import { UpdaterModal } from "@/components/ui/updater-modal";
import { createAppUpdater } from "@/hooks/create-app-updater";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

export function AppUpdater() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = createSignal(false);

  const updater = createAppUpdater({
    autoCheck: true,
    currentVersion: "v1.0.0",
    onUpdateAvailable: () => setIsOpen(true),
  });

  return (
    <>
      <Button onClick={() => updater.checkForUpdates()}>
        Check for Updates
      </Button>

      <UpdaterModal
        open={isOpen()}
        onOpenChange={setIsOpen}
        updater={updater}
        appName="Nikala Studio"
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Global Hotkeys (`createGlobalShortcut`)
```tsx
import { createGlobalShortcut } from "@/hooks/create-global-shortcut";

createGlobalShortcut({
  shortcut: ["CommandOrControl+Shift+K", "Alt+Space"],
  onTrigger: (key) => {
    console.log("Global hotkey fired:", key);
  },
});
```
